name: fast-compaction
description: Verbatim judge-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

asker.title: Judge
asker.description: cloud = TypeSafe Jev API (apiKey required); ollama = local Ollama System One endpoint (no key needed)

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum judge probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

preserveStartMessages.title: Start messages to preserve
preserveStartMessages.description: Number of oldest messages the token budget never demotes; active with target floor compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction. Keep it at the host's auto-compact point (~95): every compaction rewrites the prompt-cache suffix, so compacting earlier wastes cache for no gain.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

targetFloorStartPercent.title: Target floor start (%)
targetFloorStartPercent.description: Compaction target as a percentage of the context window, starting here; steps down after each accepted judge compaction and resets on any fallback to the built-in summary.

targetFloorMinPercent.title: Target floor minimum (%)
targetFloorMinPercent.description: Lowest percentage of the context window the compaction target may step down to.

targetFloorStepPercent.title: Target floor step (%)
targetFloorStepPercent.description: Percentage points the compaction target steps down after each accepted judge compaction.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum judge state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every judge request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum judge request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Token budget for state plus questions in one judge request. State and batch sizes derive automatically and can never exceed it; keep it at least ~2000 below the judge endpoint's context (shim default num_ctx 32768).

maxQuestionsPerRequest.title: Max questions per request
maxQuestionsPerRequest.description: Judge questions sent per request (call batches get half: two questions per call). Route limit 64; practical ceiling is the engine's 30s per-request abort at roughly 1.5s per question on a shared GPU.

askConcurrency.title: Judge request concurrency
askConcurrency.description: Judge requests in flight at once; 2 matches Ollama's default parallel slots.

duplicateKeepLast.title: Identical call repeats kept
duplicateKeepLast.description: Older repeats of an identical tool call (same tool, same input) are dropped without asking the judge; only the newest N of each distinct call survive. 0 disables.

sliceMap.title: Slice map
sliceMap.description: Include cross-slice context in every judge state: slice position, window-wide tool histogram and the user-prompt thread. Enable after retraining the judge on map-shaped data.

timeBudgetMs.title: Compaction time budget (ms)
timeBudgetMs.description: Stop asking the judge after this long: unanswered candidates stay and the next compaction judges the remainder. Leave empty to derive it: judge timeout minus 40s, capped at 110s (engine kills hooks at ~2min).

floodWindowMs.title: Flood guard window (ms)
floodWindowMs.description: Sliding window in which repeated compactions of one loop count as thrashing.

floodMinCompactions.title: Compactions that signal thrashing
floodMinCompactions.description: Compactions of one loop within the flood guard window before its tools can be denied as refill drivers. Healthy deep reading is never denied.

floodMinCallsSinceCompact.title: Refill driver calls
floodMinCallsSinceCompact.description: Calls of one tool since the loop's last compaction before it is named the refill driver and denied while the loop is thrashing.

toolCallLimit.title: Repeated tool call limit (backstop)
toolCallLimit.description: Optional hard backstop: max calls of one tool within the window before further calls are denied with guidance. 0 (default) disables it — the effect-based flood guard is the primary restraint.

toolCallWindowMs.title: Tool call limit window (ms)
toolCallWindowMs.description: Sliding window for the toolCallLimit backstop; old calls are forgotten after this.

compactRegainPercent.title: Compaction regain percent
compactRegainPercent.description: Auto-compact only after the context regrew this % of the window above its post-compaction low. The fixed per-request overhead (system prompt + tool schemas) can sit below the trigger percentage; without this guard compaction would re-fire every turn. 0 disables.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when the judge decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

model.title: Judge model
model.description: Model name sent with every request (e.g. jev-latest, or clef-flash on a local Ollama).

baseUrl.title: Judge endpoint (local model)
baseUrl.description: Full System One endpoint to post to. Set to e.g. http://desktop:11434/v1/systemone to use a local Ollama decision model; then no API key is needed. Leave empty for the TypeSafe cloud.

ollamaUrl.title: Ollama endpoint
ollamaUrl.description: System One endpoint of the local Ollama judge, used when asker is ollama

judgeTimeoutMs.title: Judge timeout (ms)
judgeTimeoutMs.description: How long compaction waits for the judge before falling back to the built-in summary; keep it under the engine's hook budget.
